gates.name: STAGE1_ENTRY_PROVEN
gates.acceptance: The exact Stage 1 squash commit and all inherited authority digests are verified.

gates.name: ORACLE_INDEPENDENCE_PROVEN
gates.acceptance: The oracle is side-effect-free, separately packaged, and structurally isolated from production runtime code.

gates.name: CANONICAL_PRIMITIVES_PROVEN
gates.acceptance: Strict parsing, checked arithmetic, timestamps, digests, identities, replay, and conflict match frozen vectors.

gates.name: FINANCIAL_EXPECTATIONS_PROVEN
gates.acceptance: Transaction and settlement expected results match frozen examples and adversarial semantic cases.

gates.name: ATOMIC_OUTPUT_BOUNDARY_PROVEN
gates.acceptance: Identity and revision expectations are modeled without authoritative persistence and failures emit no proof.

gates.name: ADVERSARIAL_COVERAGE_PROVEN
gates.acceptance: Invariant, scenario, boundary, metamorphic, and mutation coverage is complete with zero mandatory survivors.

gates.name: REPRODUCIBLE_CANDIDATE_PROVEN
gates.acceptance: Two clean exact-toolchain runs agree and external closure requirements are fail-closed.
